phases.title: Identity, Scope, And Ownership Lock
phases.exitCriteria: Pack promise, boundaries, module ownership, non-goals, and release gates are locked.

phases.title: Protocol Scaffold And Pack Spine
phases.exitCriteria: echogalacticsurveyprotocol loads with starter outpost, Terminal, HoloMap, Index, and save-state surfaces.

phases.title: Survey Data Contracts And Seed Content
phases.exitCriteria: Sectors, bodies, probes, routes, discoveries, salvage, loot, and depots validate cleanly.

phases.title: First 30-Minute Vertical Slice
phases.exitCriteria: Opening loop plays from outpost wake to first fuel-canister route objective.

phases.title: Probe Launch, Scan Confidence, And Recovery Loop
phases.exitCriteria: Probe launches produce imperfect but useful sector decisions across 3-5 launches.

phases.title: HoloMap Sector, Route, And Catalog Overlays
phases.exitCriteria: Map shows unknowns, scan cones, fuel range, route risk, depots, and catalog state.

phases.title: Catalog, Missions, And Certification Progression
phases.exitCriteria: Cataloging bodies, anomalies, wrecks, and routes unlocks missions, badges, and map layers.

phases.title: Fuel Routes, Logistics, And Remote Depots
phases.exitCriteria: Fuel range, fuel quality, return safety, cargo, and one remote depot alter route decisions.

phases.title: Orbital Salvage, Hazards, And Upgrade Pressure
phases.exitCriteria: At least one wreck is playable, readable, risky, and rewards a meaningful probe or route upgrade.

phases.title: Full Arc, Edition Packaging, And Release Gate
phases.exitCriteria: Native, NeoForge, Standalone, Launcher, first-30, first-2-hour, and Survey Array evidence all pass.
